﻿# Prismata

Current version: 0.1.3

Prismata is a cybernetic development ecosystem that organizes governance, runtime workspace state, tooling, and project domains into a single coherent scaffold.

## Repository Intent

Prismata separates:

- what should happen (governance and canonical standards)
- what is happening now (workspace runtime state)
- what has happened (historical record)

This keeps implementation concerns, policy, and audit history distinct while still coordinated.

## Canonical Top-Level Layout

- .workspace/ : untracked runtime workspace for instantiated config, working memory, audit trails, temporary files, data files, cache, and session/history state
- Meta/ : tracked governance and canonical assets (schemas, manifests, registries, copilot instructions, config sections, manifest sections)
- Historical/ : tracked historical archive of decisions, architecture evolution, and operational history
- Mind_Body/ : cybernetic linkage layer connecting orchestration/tooling to mind, knowledge, body, brain, and nervous-system domains
- Projects/ : transitional project landing area (planned evolution toward Core, Infrastructure, Tenant destination roots)
- Projects/Tooling/ : validator/scaffolding/operations tooling domain

## Workspace Contract

The .workspace scaffold is intentionally local-runtime focused.

Expected responsibilities include:

- instantiated project config snapshots
- runtime logs and temporary outputs
- project data ingress/egress staging
- system cache, session state, and short-lived operational memory

This area is not intended to represent canonical governance truth.

## Governance Contract

The Meta scaffold is the source of policy and canonical definitions.

Expected responsibilities include:

- canonical schemas and manifest templates
- canonical config and manifest section bundles
- copilot instruction baselines
- governance plans and migration inventory

Operational runtime outputs should not be treated as canonical when a Meta equivalent exists.

## Shared CLI Menu Standard

Prismata now standardizes interactive CLI menu behavior via `tUilKit` shared menu modules and tenant menu trees under `.workspace/projects.menus/`.

Current rollout includes:

- `V4l1d8r` full multi-level menu tree wiring
- `M3m01r5` tenant main menu wiring
- `PrismCommander` tenant main menu wiring

## Historical Contract

Historical captures how the system evolved over time.

Expected responsibilities include:

- architecture evolution artifacts
- migration and change records
- major decision history
- deprecated model and pattern records

Historical is a reflection layer, not a prescriptive policy layer.

## Current Direction

- Keep governance assets in Meta.
- Keep historical artifacts in Historical at repository root.
- Keep runtime/ephemeral workspace state in .workspace.
- Keep Mind_Body as the orchestration-to-cybernetics linkage model.
- Continue transitioning Projects toward explicit Core, Infrastructure, and Tenant roots.

## Contributing Notes

- Prefer config-driven paths and root modes over hardcoded machine paths.
- Preserve deterministic naming and schema/manifest alignment.
- Update governance artifacts when structure or policy changes.
- Preserve historical context when moving or deprecating architecture components.
